name: post_note
description: Writes a note on the current run's shared blackboard (team or goal): decisions made, artifacts produced, open points — visible to every colleague in THIS run. Not persistent memory: the note disappears when the run ends. Use a short, descriptive 'key' (e.g. 'db-decision', 'config-file-created') so colleagues can filter with read_notes.

key.description: Short key identifying the note (e.g. 'decision', 'artifact', 'blocker'). Used by read_notes for filtering.

value.description: The note's content: what you decided, produced, or left open for colleagues.
